42solder joints
difficulty

A 16-channel Pico 2 logic analyzer in a printed case

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    TRIG_BRIDGEPico 2 GP0 · Pico 2 GP1
    GNDPico 2 GND.1 · Probe A GND1
    CH1Pico 2 GP2 · Probe A CH1
    CH2Pico 2 GP3 · Probe A CH2
    CH3Pico 2 GP4 · Probe A CH3
    CH4Pico 2 GP5 · Probe A CH4
    CH5Pico 2 GP6 · Probe A CH5
    CH6Pico 2 GP7 · Probe A CH6
    CH7Pico 2 GP8 · Probe A CH7
    CH8Pico 2 GP9 · Probe A CH8
    GNDPico 2 GND.3 · Probe A GND2
    GNDPico 2 GND.4 · Probe B GND1
    CH9Pico 2 GP10 · Probe B CH9
    CH10Pico 2 GP11 · Probe B CH10
    CH11Pico 2 GP12 · Probe B CH11
    CH12Pico 2 GP13 · Probe B CH12
    CH13Pico 2 GP14 · Probe B CH13
    CH14Pico 2 GP15 · Probe B CH14
    CH15Pico 2 GP16 · Probe B CH15
    CH16Pico 2 GP17 · Probe B CH16
    GNDPico 2 GND.8 · Probe B GND2
  3. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  4. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
17SPOR-WIRE-1

Spor is built

Spor is the barebones build of gusmanb's open-source LogicAnalyzer: a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 running the upstream firmware, with sixteen channels brought out to two probe headers on the front of a small printed case. It is for an embedded hobbyist who wants to see UART, I2C and SPI traffic on 3.3 V boards without buying a commercial analyzer. The desktop LogicAnalyzer program captures and decodes; nothing here replaces it.
